gnosh mcp logout

  Forget the sign-in to a server at a URL. The authorization server is not
  told: the token it gave may still work until it runs out.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh mcp logout [flags] <name>

Flags
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
